paragraph: They take it for **granted** that what is new is better than what is old. **Grant** had never been able to make much money. He was awarded a **grant** to study in Germany.
arabicDesc: مثال: يعتقدون أن كل ما هو جديد أفضل مما هو قديم.

other.meaning: The act of granting or giving (noun)

paragraph: The company was started with $100,000 in **capital**. What's the **capital** of the United States? Please do not forget **capital** letters.
arabicDesc: مثال: تأسست الشركة برأس مال يبلغ 100.000 دولار.

paragraph: Low temperatures turn water into **ice**. It's as cold as **ice**. I told you to have the **ice** box fixed.
arabicDesc: مثال: انخفاض درجة الحرارة يحول الماء إلى جليد.

paragraph: My **husband** makes a hundred thousand dollars a year. You already have a wonderful **husband** that loves you. My **husband** doesn't know I'm with you.
arabicDesc: مثال: يجني زوجي مائة ألف دولار سنويا.

other.meaning: To manage or administer carefully and frugally (verb)

paragraph: He had no other **resource** but to run away. I use the Internet as a **resource** for my research. A library is the best **resource** for books.
english: something that one uses to achieve an objective

paragraph: I am **honored** to meet you. I can't tell you what an **honor** this is. You always have the **honor** of being the first.
arabicDesc: مثال: إنه لشرف لي أن ألتقي بك .

paragraph: I intend to stay at a five-star **hotel**. I will stay at the **hotel** for now. I'm looking for the people who are running this **hotel**.
arabicDesc: مثال: أنوي الإقامة في فندقٍ من فئة الخمسة نجوم.

paragraph: I don't have anything **except** for ten books. I work every day **except** Sunday. Everybody is busy **except** me.
english: introducing a noun or noun phrase forming an exception or qualification
arabicDesc: مثال: ليس عندي إلا عشرة كتب.

other.meaning: Loosely, used to introduce a contrastive statement explaining why something wasn't successful, didn't happen, etc (conjunction)

paragraph: Employees of the company went on **strike**. Picking out the right man, he would **strike** him. We will call a **strike** to demand our rights.
arabicDesc: مثال: نظم موظفو الشركة إضرابا.

other.meaning: The act of knocking down all ten pins on the first roll of a frame (noun)

paragraph: **Spring** Festival is also known as Chinese New Year. When is the first day of **spring**? This is a tree in the **spring**.
english: season between winter and summer in temperate climates
arabicDesc: مثال: يعرف "مهرجان الربيع" بالعام الصيني الجديد أيضاً.

paragraph: I don't know whether I'll **purchase** these or not. You have to register before putting your **purchase** through. We will **purchase** a new car next week.
english: the acquisition of title to, or property in, anything for a price
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: اشتراء

other.meaning: that which is obtained for a price in money or its equivalent
To buy, obtain by payment of a price in money or its equivalent (verb)

paragraph: He got up at **eight** in the morning. I got married **eight** years ago. The gate is closed at **eight**.
arabicDesc: مثال: نهض من النوم في الساعة الثامنة صباحاً.

paragraph: You should make the best of your **limited** time. This offer is available for a **limited** time only. Don't pay him any attention, his brain is **limited**.
english: with certain limits placed upon it

paragraph: Then just forget her. Leave her in **peace**. We can't live in **peace** without respect. We want **peace** in the world.
english: state of being free from war
arabicDesc: مثال: لما لا تنساها و لا تتركها و شأنها؟

paragraph: New facts about ancient China have **recently** come to light. I have not felt well **recently**. Have you **recently** lost weight?
arabicDesc: مثال: كُشِفت حديثًا حقائق جديدة فيما يتعلق بالصين القديمة.

paragraph: If it rains **tomorrow**, will you stay at home? Let's have a tea party the day after **tomorrow**. The weather report says it will rain **tomorrow** afternoon.
english: the day after the present day
arabicDesc: مثال: هل ستبقى في المنزل إذا أمطرت غداً؟

paragraph: You have to get off **via** the back door. She went to Europe **via** the United States. There was communication with Earth **via** online communication.
Do you have anything to say **regarding** this? He is **regarded** as the best doctor in the village. Do you know what I think in this **regard**?
english: to think of someone or something in a certain way
arabicDesc: مثال: هل لديك ما تقوله بخصوص هذا الأمر؟

paragraph: He listens to a short wave **radio** station. I listen to the **radio** every night. Last night you forgot to turn off the **radio**, didn't you?
arabicDesc: مثال: يستمع إلى محطة مذياع موجة قصيرة.

paragraph: The police set out to solve the **crime**. That man who committed that **crime** was out of his mind. The police gathered a lot of evidence from the **crime** scene.
english: specific act committed in violation of the law
arabicDesc: مثال: الشرطة انطلقت لتحل الجريمة

paragraph: Why don't you just start at the **beginning**? I'm **beginning** to feel cold. At the **beginning**, he didn't believe it at all.
english: act of doing that which begins anything
arabicDesc: مثال: لم لا تبدأ من البداية؟

paragraph: I would like to make a **request**. I hope that you'll accept my **request**. She turned down my **request**.
english: to express the need or desire for
arabicDesc: مثال: أود أن أقدم على طلب.

other.meaning: Act of requesting (with the adposition at in the presence of possessives, and on in their absence) (noun)

paragraph: What is your **favorite** music group? My **favorite** music is pop music. One hundred is my **favorite** number.
english: liked more than others of the same kind
arabicDesc: مثال: ما هي فرقَتُكَ الموسيقيّة المفضّلة؟

paragraph: They kept it **secret** that they were in love. I don't want this **secret** to be exposed. Why did you keep that a **secret**?
arabicDesc: مثال: أبقَوْ حبهما سراً.

paragraph: The **function** of the machine is to save work. I can't **function** without my morning cup of coffee. Electric cars don't **function** as well in cold weather.
english: what something does or is used for

paragraph: He is a **potential** world champion. Try to develop your leadership **potential**. Do you have leadership **potential**?
english: possible in the future; ability that may develop
arabicDesc: مثال: بإمكانه أن يصبح بطلاً للعالم.

paragraph: The **bear** is eating an apple. He was **born** in this very room. I'm happy that I was **born**.
arabicDesc: مثال: إنّ الدّبّ يأكل تفّاحة.

other.meaning: To carry or convey, literally or figuratively (verb)

paragraph: You seem as one about to **reveal** something new. The police will **reveal** the truth of the case. You show that you have something new to **reveal**.
He **kicked** in a lot of money. He likes to **kick** back with some music on. They're going to **kick** me out of the country.
english: strike with or raise the foot or leg
arabicDesc: مثال: ساهم بالكثير من المال.

other.meaning: A hit or strike with the leg, foot or knee (noun)

paragraph: Based on **Western** standards, our house is too small. He doesn't want to live in a **Western** country. He lives in a mixed Japanese-**Western**-style house.
I still don't think it's **fair**. The article covers all the events at the **fair**. It's **fair** today, so we can work all day.
arabicDesc: مثال: لازلت غير مقتنعا بعدالة ذلك.

paragraph: You don't need to repeat it a **thousand** times. He notices a **thousand** times a day the difference. They promised to give a **thousand** pieces per month.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا تحتاج لتكراره ألف مرّة.

paragraph: When did you get back from your **trip**? Have a good **trip** and call me. What's the purpose of your **trip**?
arabicDesc: مثال: متى عدت من رحلتك؟

other.meaning: period of time in which one experiences drug-induced reverie or hallucinations
To fall over or stumble over an object as a result of striking it with one's foot (verb)

paragraph: The sun gives us light and **heat**. Go **heat** up some water. I can't take the **heat**.
arabicDesc: مثال: تعطينا الشمسُ الضوءَ والحرارةَ.

other.meaning: condition or quality of being hot
To cause an increase in temperature of (an object or space) (verb)

paragraph: Too much stress can lead to physical **disease**. I have completely got over the **disease**. He didn't go to study because of his **disease**.
english: an abnormal condition of the body causing discomfort or dysfunction
arabicDesc: مثال: الكثير من الضغط ربما يؤدي إلى مرض عضوي.

paragraph: Are you sure we're going in the right **direction**? I am afraid to drive a car in one-**direction** streets. They're going in the same **direction**.
arabicDesc: مثال: هل أنتَ مُتأكِّد أنّنا نسير في الاتّجاه الصّحيح؟

paragraph: We have never heard him **sing** the song. Remember why you love to **sing**. I will **sing** you to sleep.
english: to produce harmonious sounds with one’s voice
arabicDesc: مثال: لم نسمعه يغني الأغنية قط.

paragraph: Can you read that sign **ahead** of us? Go **ahead** and call the police. We got **ahead** in life.
english: in front, or in the future
arabicDesc: مثال: أيمكنك قراءة اللافتة التي أمامنا؟

paragraph: **Chinese** is harder than other foreign languages. In Africa, **Chinese** construction firms hire locals. I have never eaten **Chinese** food.
english: of, from, or relating to China, its people, its culture, or its language
arabicDesc: مثال: اللغة الصينية أصعب من اللغات الأجنبية الأخرى.

other.meaning: The Standard Chinese language, written in Chinese characters and spoken and spelled using Standard Mandarin pronunciation (noun)
A native, inhabitant, or citizen of China, particularly of the People's Republic of China (noun)

paragraph: I'm just a **normal** girl. This is **normal** to me. Life quickly returned to **normal**.
arabicDesc: مثال: لستُ سوى فتاة عاديّة.

paragraph: **Russian** is very difficult to learn. Why don't I write in **Russian**? I want to learn **Russian**.
arabicDesc: مثال: اللغة الروسية صعبة جدًا للتعلم.

other.meaning: A citizen or national of Russia (noun)

paragraph: This never happened in my **adult** life. There were only three **adults** in the room. Only **adults** may watch that film.
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يحدث ذلك أبدا في حياتي كإنسان بالغ.

paragraph: He is **suffering** from a cold. I hope you **suffer** as much as we did. Don't **suffer** by yourself. Find someone to help you.
arabicDesc: مثال: يعاني من البرد

paragraph: I am **determined** to be a scientist. We should **determine** what is to be done first. How do you **determine** whether this information is correct?
english: to find out exactly, or to decide
arabicDesc: مثال: عقدتُ العزم على أن أكون عالمًا.

paragraph: Is there anything in **particular** you want to do? What I wanted to say concerns this **particular** issue. I mean students in general, but not in **particular**.
This hospital has a lot of **brand**-new equipment. Maybe I will buy a **brand**-new computer. What **brand** of dog food do you feed your dog?
english: a mark or scar made by burning with a hot iron, especially to mark cattle or to classify the contents of a cask
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: شعار

other.meaning: a specific product, service, or provider so distinguished

paragraph: This **location** has the best view in the city. Every year I find myself at a different **location**. The school changed **location** several times over the years.
english: a particular point or place in physical space
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مكان، موضع

paragraph: It's important to understand the **impact** of your words. What book has had the biggest **impact** on you? This can even **impact** the quality of your sleep.
You are a good **customer**. Is the **customer** always right? I don't see a single **customer** in this store.
english: one who purchases or receives a product or service
arabicDesc: مثال: أنت مشتر جيد.

paragraph: My office is on the fifth **floor**. She went down to the fifth **floor**. Stop leaving clothes all over the **floor**.
arabicDesc: مثال: مكتبي في الطابق الخامس.

paragraph: The **solution** he proposed was completely out of the question. We'll find a **solution**, I'm sure. I don't have a **solution**.
english: an act, plan or other means, used or proposed, to solve a problem.
arabicDesc: مثال: الحل الّذي اقترحَهُ مستحيل تماماً.

paragraph: I **imagine** a house where I'm happy. When I close my eyes I **imagine** I am a bird and can fly. That's not how I **imagined** you at all.
english: (transitive) to form a mental image of something
arabicDesc: مثال: أتخيل منزلا أكون فيه سعيدا.

paragraph: There are a lot of problems we can't **avoid**. You must **avoid** making those kinds of mistakes. We always take the bad to **avoid** the worst.
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك الكثير من المشاكل التي لا يمكننا تجنبها.

paragraph: I couldn't **recognize** him, not having met him before. I didn't **recognize** any of them. He didn't **recognize** that bird.
english: to match in memory; to know from a previous encounter
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يكن بإمكاني أن أتعرف عليه لأني لم ألتقه من قبل.

paragraph: Changing rooms won't help you **hide**. We can **hide** in here. Where did you **hide** them?
english: (intransitive) put oneself in a place where one will be harder to find
arabicDesc: مثال: الاختباء في غرفة أخرى لن يساعدك.

other.meaning: (transitive) put in a place where it will be harder to discover

paragraph: Let me help you. Your bags look very **heavy**. I could not come because of the **heavy** rain. The **heavy** rain caused all the trains to stop.
arabicDesc: مثال: دَعني أُساعدك. حقائبك تبدو ثقيلة.

paragraph: We were behind a computer **screen**. The **screen** went dark again. I looked at what was on the computer **screen**.
english: viewing area of electronic output device
arabicDesc: مثال: كنا خلف شاشة حاسوب.

paragraph: Do you believe in the power of **positive** thinking? You need to be more **positive** about your work. Language is a system of differences without **positive** terms.

other.meaning: A thing capable of being affirmed (noun)

paragraph: I just got off the phone with my **agent**. My **agent** told me my name wasn't star material. The government **agent** arrested the man for his crimes.
english: one who exerts power, or has the power to act

paragraph: You **certainly** have a lot of questions. Summer has **certainly** passed by quickly. He **certainly** didn't expect that.
arabicDesc: مثال: أكيد لديك كثير من الأسئلة.

paragraph: She deserves a guy who can love her **completely**. I **completely** refuse to be a part of this game. I haven't been **completely** honest with you.
arabicDesc: مثال: هي تستحقّ رجلا يحبّها كثيرا.

other.meaning: to the fullest extent or degree

paragraph: **Despite** his best attempts, the car would not start. **Despite** his young age, he speaks so many languages. **Despite** different languages and cultures, everyone still became friends.
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: بالرغم من، مع

paragraph: **Hi**. If I'm not mistaken, you're our new neighbors, aren't you? **Hi**, Bill. How are you? He didn't even say **hi**.
arabicDesc: مثال: مرحباً. إذا لم أكُن مُخطِئاً, أنتَ جارنا الجديد. اليس كذلك؟

paragraph: The movie was **interesting**, as I had expected. This book is even more **interesting** than that. No one expects you to be **interesting** all the time.
arabicDesc: مثال: كان الفلم شيقاً كما تخيلت أن يكون.

paragraph: I was **nearly** run over by a truck. It's **nearly** certain that the truth will come out. I dreamed about you **nearly** every night last week.
arabicDesc: مثال: كادت شاحنةٌ تدهسُنِي.

paragraph: This article is more interesting than the **previous** one. No day is the same as the **previous** one. This book was first published in the **previous** year.
You have to help her, but **quickly**. Children grow up very **quickly**. You must help him, **quickly**!
arabicDesc: مثال: يجب أن تساعدها و بسرعة!

paragraph: I have an **extra** ticket. I hope we get paid **extra** for doing that. It never hurts to get a little **extra** practice.
arabicDesc: مثال: عندي تذكرة زائدة.

paragraph: They never **discuss** anything with me. Let's **discuss** that problem later. We will **discuss** that later.
english: to converse or debate concerning a particular topic
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يناقشوا أي شيء معي.

paragraph: When I want to **cry**, I think of you. I didn't want to **cry** in front of him. I can't believe I made him **cry**.
arabicDesc: مثال: حين أريد أن أبكي، فإني أفكر فيك.

paragraph: How much is the **dollar** now? He only paid ten **dollars** for that shirt. You must give me 500 **dollars** right now.
arabicDesc: مثال: بكم الدولار الأن؟

paragraph: In the evening, a **vehicle** stopped outside the door. The **vehicle** stopped and the driver opened the door. The stolen **vehicle** was found in a car park.
english: a conveyance: a spacious device for carrying or transporting substances, objects, people or animals
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: وسيلة، عربة، مركبة

paragraph: I get a three percent **commission** on anything I sell. The **commission** has promised to take action soon. He went in front of this **commission**.
english: a sending or mission (to do or accomplish something)

paragraph: I met her in a coffee **shop** near the station. The **shop** is open from Monday to Saturday. Maybe we should go to the repair **shop**.
arabicDesc: مثال: قابلتها في المقهى القريب من المحطة.

other.meaning: To visit stores or shops to browse or explore merchandise, especially with the intention of buying such merchandise (verb)

paragraph: The computer is often compared to the human **brain**. I'm a woman. I think with a female **brain**. Sometimes I question if he even has a **brain**.
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مخ، نفوخ

paragraph: I don't have the **skill** required to do that. It looks like that takes a lot of **skill**. This work calls for a high degree of **skill**.
english: a capacity to do something well

paragraph: Didn't it **occur** to you to shut the windows? When did the error **occur**? Has it never **occurred** to you that you might be wrong?
arabicDesc: مثال: ألم يخطر لك أن تغلق النوافذ؟

paragraph: We have no choice but to believe in **justice**. To do him **justice**, he's done some good work. I don't think **justice** was done in this case.
english: fairness, especially with regard to punishment
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: عدل

other.meaning: state of being just or fair

paragraph: I can't get by on such a small **income**. His **income** is too small to support his family. The city government promised us more low-**income** housing.
english: money one earns by working or by capitalising on the work of others
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: إيراد

paragraph: It rained **throughout** the night. It's open ten to six daily **throughout** the year. You are loved and missed **throughout** the world, man.
english: in every part of; all through
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد امطرت طوال الليل

paragraph: This **item** now accounts for 20 percent of our sales. Can you do a price check on this **item**? Let's go to the next **item** on the list.
That child was left in the **sun** too long. The moon is the dream of the **sun**. This room does not get much **sun**.
english: a star, especially when seen as the centre of any single solar system
arabicDesc: مثال: تُرك ذاك الطفل في الشمس مدة طويلة للغاية.

other.meaning: The star at the center of the Solar System (our solar system), which shines in our sky (noun)

paragraph: I don't want you to **worry** about me. Now that I am here, you don't have to **worry**. Don't **worry**. Didn't I say that everything would go well?
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أريدك أن تقلق بشأني.

paragraph: You can hear English on **Channel** 1, and Japanese on **Channel** 7. Do you know this **channel**? I'm not watching it. You can change the **channel**.
english: the hollow bed of running waters
arabicDesc: مثال: يمكنك سماع الإنجليزية على المحطة ١ و اليابانية على المحطة ٧.

paragraph: We sent them a **copy**. I am hoping to get two **copies** of this book. How many **copies** do you need?
arabicDesc: مثال: أرسلنا لهم نسخة.

paragraph: We can **deliver** it this evening. Try to **deliver** high-quality work at the office. I have a message I want you to **deliver**.
english: to set free from restraint or danger
arabicDesc: مثال: يمكننا أن نوصله الليلة.

paragraph: May I **introduce** my friend to you? He **introduced** his sister to me. Aren't you going to **introduce** me to your date?
english: to cause someone to be acquainted
arabicDesc: مثال: أعرّفك بصديقي.

paragraph: Why don't you **pop** in for a drink tonight? My most favorite style of music is **pop** music. I'll **pop** by at the start of the holidays.
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: موسيقى شعبية

paragraph: He doesn't mean to be mean. It's just his **nature**. **Nature** needs to be left as it is. She wants to live close to **nature**.
english: the natural world and its order
arabicDesc: مثال: إنه لا يقصد أن يعامل الآخرين بقسوة. إنها طبيعته فحسب.

paragraph: So what did you do last **weekend**? Where did you go last **weekend**? She spent the **weekend** by herself.
english: the days at the end of the week when many people do not work
arabicDesc: مثال: إذا ماذا فعلت نهاية الأسبوع الماضي؟

paragraph: Please don't **hang** up. Give me a chance to explain what's happening. Don't **hang** up yet, please. A lot of pictures are **hung** in the meeting room.
arabicDesc: مثال: رجاء لا تغلق الهاتف أعطني فرصة لأشرح لك ما القصة.

other.meaning: to execute by suspension from the neck

paragraph: I don't want us to **separate**. Our teacher **separated** us into two groups. It's time for us to go our **separate** ways.
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أريد أن ننفصل.

paragraph: Your task will be to train the **employees** on the new computer system. She's not a full-time **employee** of this company. I was **employee** of the year for three years.
english: person who provides labor to a company or another person
arabicDesc: مثال: سوف تكون مهمتك تدريب الموظفين على نظام الكمبيوتر الجديد.

paragraph: It is possible to train the **memory** by drinking coffee. I have no **memory** of what happened. You do not have a good **memory**.
arabicDesc: مثال: من الممكن تدريب الذاكرة من خلال شرب القهوة.

paragraph: Why don't you wear a **ring**? Did you lose your **ring**? Do you know what it means when a man presents a **ring** to a woman?
arabicDesc: مثال: لما لا ترتدي خاتما؟

other.meaning: (tr.) to produce a sound by ringing

paragraph: I would like to get a **camera** like this. He showed me how to use this **camera**. Don't forget to take a **camera** with you.
arabicDesc: مثال: لكم أريد الحصول على كاميرا مثل تلك!

paragraph: How do you **maintain** and improve your language skills? They worked together to **maintain** peace in their town. How do you think we **maintain** order around here?
I agree with you **absolutely**. I have **absolutely** no idea where I should go. There was **absolutely** nothing you could do about it.
arabicDesc: مثال: أوافقك الرأي بالتأكيد.

paragraph: This **additional** work will take about two hours more. I had to pay an **additional** three dollars. This was an **additional** fund for buying books.
I love you **beyond** words. Except those, I guess. Why he wants to go there is **beyond** me. He sometimes told me stories from **beyond** the seas.
